Topic.label: Comparing and Calculating with Line Segments

Question: Points A, B, and C lie on the same line, with \(AB=10\text{ cm}\) and \(BC=4\text{ cm}\). What is the length of AC, in cm? (If there are multiple answers, separate them with commas, in any order.)
Solution: There are two cases: when C lies on the extension of AB, \(AC=10+4=14\); when C lies on segment AB, \(AC=10-4=6\).

Original.prompt: A、B、C 三点在同一条直线上，AB=10 cm，BC=4 cm，则 AC 的长是多少 cm？（有多个答案时用逗号隔开，顺序不限）
Original.explanation: 分两种情况：点 C 在 AB 延长线上时 AC=10+4=14；点 C 在线段 AB 上时 AC=10-4=6。
